names.note: Name page of days.pravoslavie.ru for this memory is «Евфросиния (Денисова), мц.»; the grade and the rank are stripped and the surname kept, the day line itself giving only the forename. `fk.mjs` on the stored string returns NONE.

death.note: The day line closes «(1942)», which is the whole of what the source gives; no year of birth anywhere.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 29 декабря ст. ст. — «Мцц. Наталии , Наталии , Евдокии , Анны , Матроны , Варвары , Анны , Евдокии , Евфросинии , Агриппины и Наталии (1942).»

attestations.note: THE LINE AND THE NAME PAGE ARE ALL THERE IS: no life page stands behind this entry. THE LINE ENUMERATES ELEVEN FORENAMES — three Natalias, two Annas, two Eudocias, and a Matrona, a Barbara, a Euphrosyne and an Agrippina — AND THIS DRAFT HOLDS ALL ELEVEN. The line itself gives forenames only; the eleven numbered name pages behind it give eleven different surnames, and those are what tell the repeats apart. A Cyrillic grep for «Денисова» over every `saint.json` returns nothing. The day page prints seven hymns — two for Mark the Gravedigger, two for the venerable Marcellus and three for the fourteen thousand infants — and none under this name.
